segments: "POST-IT LOVE" in bold white text fades in on a black screen, then quickly fades out

Black screen fades to a photo of a building framed and hung on a lilac wall. "Post-it Love" in pink text appears in the upper left corner of the photo frame before fading out. A drum beat starts in the background
Camera cuts to a woman standing in front of a printer, looking down. Upbeat whistle music starts playing
Camera pans over a border to reveal a man's hands, also making copies of something
The man and woman stand up simultaneously. They both turn their heads and see each other.
The man walks to his desk and starts to sit down
When he opens the folder, the man finds a smiley face made using pink post it notes inside.
The man scoots back in his chair and looks around in confusion.
The man smiles, looking at the folder, before scooting up
The woman gets to her desk. She sets down her stuff and goes to open the blinds
Cut to the man standing in the bathroom. He's looking into the mirror and straightening his tie.
Camera cuts to the inside of a supply closet, dark. The door opens and the woman walks in before closing the door
The woman walks out of the supply closet with an armful of post it notes. She turns off the light and closes the door behind her
The woman slows to a stop as she notices something in front of her. The camera pans out as the music swells
The man turns to notice the woman standing there
The woman, still in shock, stares back
